rule: An executable or control-plane change required by an accepted PROJECT_CHANGE_REQUIRED study may be materialized only into a separate implementation PR. The inbox may carry proposal and payload bytes, but protected main must first authorize the exact candidate, proposal, review row, and operation-set hashes. The write-scoped materializer executes only protected-main code and never executes inbox payloads. If the proposal changes merge-authority's own assurance surface, the PR is still created automatically but automatic self-certification is prohibited.
